title: How Dimensional’s David Booth Learned to Stay Calm and Invest for the Long Run | Dimensional
gist: Thin podcast landing page (Informed Investor Ep. 66) featuring David Booth and Mark Gochnour: uncertainty drives investment opportunity, and markets' apparent chaos hides an underlying order that rewards staying calm and invested for the long run.

insights.claim: Dimensional's David Booth argues uncertainty is a key driver of opportunity in investing, so market volatility should not prompt investors to abandon long-run plans.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: Classic passive/factor stance: volatility is the price of the equity premium, not a timing signal.
insights.quote: Uncertainty is a key driver of opportunity in investing and in life.

insights.claim: Dimensional's view is that the stock market may look chaotic but has an underlying order that benefits disciplined long-term investors.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: Reinforces buy-and-hold flows into Dimensional-style systematic funds during drawdowns.

source_meta.author: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
